acceptance_criteria: Every durable administrative identity mutation must commit its completion event atomically with the mutation, or fail closed before the mutation. Unknown providers must not inherit a non-atomic fallback.
Any non-atomic development fallback must be explicitly limited to a process-local volatile provider and must not run in production mode or production-safe composition.

Tenant-scoped authority must not change a global password or global profile field affecting a user associated with another tenant without explicit account-wide authority. A rejected request must leave credentials, versions, sessions and completion outbox unchanged.

The PostgreSQL mutation and outbox path must preserve rollback on completion-write failure, tenant membership scope, stable/idempotent reconciliation, bounded retries/dead-letter/manual retry, and worker runtime composition/recovery.
Evidence should include the relevant API regressions, actual PostgreSQL behavior, restart recovery and independent consumer concurrency. Identify any material gap or false claim.
